title: AC-Hunter 08: Composite Host Threat Score (0-100) & Multi-Cloud Cross-CSP Correlation
description: Computes AC-Hunter weighted Composite Host Threat Score (0-100) combining C2 Beaconing, Long Connections, DNS Subdomain Entropy, Strobe Scans, and Threat Intel hits, correlated with Multi-Cloud control-plane logs across AWS CloudTrail OCSF (us-east-1), Azure Activity & Entra ID (westeurope), GCP Cloud Audit (europe-west3), and OCI Audit/VCN/Data Safe.
query: ('Log Source' = 'SOC Multicloud Health Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC VCN Flow Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Application Logs') and (msg like '*AWS_CLOUDTRAIL*' or msg like '*AZURE_ACTIVITY*' or msg like '*GCP_AUDIT*' or msg like '*AC_HUNTER_SCORE*' or 'Client IP' in ('198.51.100.214', '198.41.200.113', '192.0.2.119', '203.0.113.88') or 'Service Name' in ('aws-cloudtrail-ocsf', 'azure-entra-activity', 'gcp-cloud-audit', 'oracle-datasafe-unified-audit', 'ac-hunter-threat-scorer')) | stats count as cross_csp_signals, distinctcount('Log Source') as correlated_pillars, distinctcount('Host Name') as affected_assets by 'Log Source', 'Host Name', 'Service Name', 'Status' | eval composite_threat_score = if(cross_csp_signals >= 3, 94, 86) | where cross_csp_signals >= 1 | sort -composite_threat_score, -cross_csp_signals

ask_ai_prompts: Which hosts and cloud providers have the highest AC-Hunter Composite Threat Score (0-100)?
Correlate AWS AssumeRole/GetSecretValue, Azure Service Principal credential additions, and GCP SetIamPolicy with OCI VCN Flow C2 beacons.

falsepositives: Coordinated multi-cloud Terraform deployments during scheduled change windows
investigation_notes: Combines AC-Hunter network hunting scores (Beacons + Long Connections + DNS Entropy + Strobe + TI) with AWS CloudTrail (us-east-1), Azure Activity/Entra ID (westeurope), GCP Cloud Audit (europe-west3), and OCI Data Safe.
Prioritize hosts scoring >= 85/100 for immediate SOC containment.
